cards.title: Admin setup → route plan
items: Admin supplies delivery points, demand, priority, time windows, fleet, algorithm, and traffic inputs. The API returns multi-vehicle routes and operating metrics.
Current Navi Mumbai preset: Turbhe depot, 12 delivery stops, and 4 vans at 65 kg each. The optimizer currently requires equal capacity across vehicles.

cards.title: Dispatch → driver workflow
items: Admin dispatches the generated plan. The Driver portal refreshes dispatch every 10 seconds and can post completed stops; the UI displays a selected vehicle route.
Current API returns the full dispatch and has no authentication or server-side per-driver access control. Driver-only data isolation is not yet enforced.

cards.title: Algorithms + research evidence
items: FastAPI calls the existing Python registry: A*, PSO, QPSO, ACO, QACO, and QA-QPSO. A* is a shortest-path reference, not a multi-vehicle VRP solver.
Saved benchmarks cover RC101, RC201, and C101: 6 algorithms × 30 runs × 3 instances = 540 runs. These are benchmark results, not real-fleet trials.

cards.title: Maps, traffic + current limits
items: The browser loads OSM tiles; FastAPI proxies OSRM street geometry and turn steps after stop order is optimized. The solver uses coordinate-based distance, not road-network costs.

Congestion is preset or Admin-modeled; no live traffic feed. Jobs and dispatch live in process memory, so restart clears state. No persistent database, cloud deployment, or API authentication is configured.
